description: The real current capability set, populated by reading backend/jewelmind/domain/schema.py Literal types and backend/jewelmind/api/routes.py's actual endpoints directly during Sprint 6. No roadmap/planned value is marked supported.
notSupported: Any jewelry category other than ring
Any ring style other than solitaire
Any band profile other than comfort_fit/flat
Any setting type other than prong/bezel
Any prong count other than 4 or 6
Professionally validated setting geometry for any stone shape (all settings are NOT_REVIEWED)
Shape-optimized prong placement (non-round placement is provisional/EXPERIMENTAL)
Stone seat, bearing, or cutter geometry (PLANNED for every setting family)
GLB/glTF preview format (evaluated and explicitly not implemented — see docs/known-limitations.md)
Any manufacturing method other than lost_wax_casting/direct_resin_printing
YAML or textual-DSL JDL input (Sprint 3, PLANNED)
